instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine strainer, rubbing it with your fingers, until the water runs mostly clear. Drain it well. Break the vermicelli into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the oil in a medium pot over medium heat. Add the vermicelli and stir constantly for 1 to 2 minutes, until deep golden brown. It burns fast, so don't walk away.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute, until every grain is coated.
Add 1 3/4 cups water and the salt. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Cover, turn the heat to low, and cook for 12 to 15 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork. Serve warm, or pack it for lunch. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days. Reheat it covered with a splash of water.
method_notes: Alpha Foodie (5 from 10 ratings) leads: vermicelli fried in oil until golden, then the rice, then water, then a covered simmer. But First Chai (5 from 2) uses butter and soaks the basmati first; this version keeps the oil so it stays vegan and skips the soak to stay quick. Water is a little under the lead's ratio because the rice is rinsed and drained.
